 statement I: Let Sunita’s present age be x. 

 Five
 years ago, her age was (x - 5). 

 In
 10 years, her age will be (x + 10). 

 Given:
 (x - 5) = ½ (x + 10) 

 Solving
 for x, we get x = 20. 

 From
 statement II: Let Sunita’s age be x. 

 Twice
 her age five years ago = 2(x - 5). 

 Given:
 x - 2(x - 5) = 10 

 Solving
 for x, we get x = 20.
questions.solutionHtml:

From statement II: Let Sunita’s age be x.

Given: x - 2(x - 5) = 10

Solving for x, we get x = 20.
